input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 is walk-away territory: it denies any transition assistance and mandates immediate permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, so the fallback (90 days of assistance; export within 30 days) is not met and 11.1 also contradicts 11.2 and 11.3. Sections 11.2 and 11.3 already supply the machine-readable return format and officer-certified deletion after Customer confirms return, so the shortest complete cure is to replace 11.1 with an expiry-or-termination trigger, up to six months' assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, and return of Customer Data within thirty days, reaching the preferred position without disturbing 11.2 or 11.3.

proposal.summary: Replace Section 11.1's immediate cessation/deletion with six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and return of Customer Data within thirty days of expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.1 currently cuts off all assistance and requires immediate deletion of our data with no export, which is a walk-away position and contradicts Sections 11.2 and 11.3. We replace it with our preferred exit terms: transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates and return of Customer Data within thirty days after expiry or termination, leaving the existing machine-readable format and certified-deletion mechanics intact.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination, Vendor shall provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates and return Customer Data within thirty days.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
mappings.quote: Vendor shall return all Customer Data in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with relationships and metadata reasonably necessary for use.

mappings.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
mappings.quote: After Customer confirms successful return, Vendor shall securely delete remaining Customer Data from active systems and, as backups cycle, from backups, except for a copy required by Applicable Law. An authorized officer shall certify deletion in writing.
